about: pipeline's application mutants; each is judged by the example's tests and laws (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test. The law that kills each is named in its rule.

mutants.name: px1-decide-cancels-closed
mutants.rule: A run that ended takes no command, a submit of its name included: Life.ClosedIsFinal.

mutants.name: px1-evolve-drops-pass
mutants.from:
case (Running as r, StagePassed):
		Running{Stages: r.Stages, Next: r.Next + 1}
mutants.rule: A passed stage moves the run to the next one: StagesPassInOrder.

mutants.name: px1-board-two-columns
mutants.rule: A run that moves leaves its old column: BoardIsFoldOfEvents.

mutants.name: px1-board-keeps-retried
mutants.to:
case run.Started:
		Some[Column]{Value: InRun}
	case run.Retried:
		None
mutants.rule: A retried run runs again: BoardIsFoldOfEvents.

mutants.name: px1-retry-gives-up-early
mutants.rule: A stage is tried Attempts times: GivesUpAfterAttempts.

mutants.name: px1-retry-order-number
mutants.rule: Each of the saga's orders names the next try, the third too: GivesUpAfterAttempts (the desk reads the next attempt, not the order, and WaitsItsBackoff sees the first order only, which this mutant keeps right).

mutants.name: px1-retry-timer-half
mutants.rule: The next try is ordered when its whole wait ends: WaitsItsBackoff.

mutants.name: px1-notify-failed-stage
mutants.from: case run.Submitted, run.Started, run.StagePassed, run.StageFailed, run.Retried:
mutants.rule: Only a run that ended gives a notice: OneNoticePerEnd.

mutants.name: px1-flaky-counts-calls
mutants.rule: A runner answers by the try, not by the calls before it: Runner.Repeatable for Flaky.

mutants.name: px1-desk-no-dedupe
mutants.rule: A resend gets the first receipt: ModelTakesEachCommandOnce.

mutants.name: px1-handle-keeps-state
mutants.rule: The step's next state is the fold of its events: SceneAgreesWithStory.

mutants.name: px1-offline-passes
mutants.from: OnFailure: func(u Offline) Signal { Ran{OK: false} }
mutants.to: OnFailure: func(u Offline) Signal { Ran{OK: true} }
mutants.rule: An offline runner is a failed try: SceneAgreesWithStory.

mutants.name: px1-desk-last-first
mutants.rule: Runs start in the order they were submitted: SceneAgreesWithStory.

mutants.name: px2-server-maps-rejection
mutants.rule: The wire answers each rejection as itself: SurfacesAgree (the wire against the model).

mutants.name: px2-cli-drops-flag
mutants.rule: The command line carries every field of a request: SurfacesAgree (the command line against the model) and ArgsRoundTrip.

mutants.name: px2-client-reorders
mutants.to: let r = rs[if i%2 == 0 && i+1 < len(rs) { i + 1 } else if i%2 == 1 { i - 1 } else { i }]
mutants.rule: The wire sends the requests in their order: SurfacesAgree (the wire against the model).

mutants.name: px3-cancel-sends-retry
mutants.rule: The button the view shows as cancel asks a cancel: SurfacesAgree (the screen against the model).

mutants.name: px3-rejection-not-shown
mutants.rule: A rejection is state the view shows as a rejection (the mutant shows it as a command taken): view.ReplyIsShown.

mutants.name: px3-stale-board
mutants.rule: An answer or a refresh fetches the board again, so an older board never stays in place of a newer one: SurfacesAgree (the screen's boards against the model's) and view.HeldTryShowsRunningThenPassed.

mutants.name: px3-running-not-shown
mutants.rule: The view shows the run the runner holds as running (the busy state): view.HeldTryShowsRunningThenPassed.

mutants.name: px3-busy-not-shown
mutants.rule: While a command is in flight the screen says so: view.HeldAskShowsSendingThenReceipt.

mutants.name: pxlog-board-skips-record
mutants.rule: The board takes every record the follower delivers: BoardFollowsTheLog.

mutants.name: pxlog-notify-forgets-cursor
mutants.rule: The notices' follower tells each record once, from its saved cursor: the cases' recorded output.

mutants.name: dk5-keep-loses-receipt
mutants.from: Tell[Ledger[S, E], Receipt]{Next: Ledger[S, E]{Stream: l.Stream, State: next, Position: r.Position, Receipts: l.Receipts.Put(id, r), Last: Recorded[E]{Position: r.Position, ID: id, Events: events}}, Output: r}
mutants.to: Tell[Ledger[S, E], Receipt]{Next: Ledger[S, E]{Stream: l.Stream, State: next, Position: r.Position, Receipts: l.Receipts, Last: Recorded[E]{Position: r.Position, ID: id, Events: events}}, Output: r}
mutants.rule: A Keep's ledger keeps the command's receipt, which the sender reads: CommandKeepsTheWait (its second submit is kept while the desk waits).

mutants.name: dk5-hosted-stay-commits
mutants.rule: A step that stays commits with Keep, so a command does not restart the wait: CommandKeepsTheWait.

mutants.name: dk5-evolve-retry-same-try
mutants.rule: A retry is the next try, so a recovered desk counts the stage's tries: RecoverAgrees, RestartMidStage.

mutants.name: dk5-evolve-failure-keeps-busy
mutants.from:
case Enter[retry.Attempt] as n:
			Waiting{Book: b, Job: Job{..j, Attempt: n.Next}}
mutants.rule: A failed try the saga retries waits: RecoverAgrees.

mutants.name: dk5-evolve-stop-keeps-job
mutants.from:
case Waiting as w:
			if w.Job.Run == e.Run { Idle{Book: left} } else { within(d, left) }
mutants.rule: A cancel of the waiting run leaves the desk idle: RecoverAgrees.
